note: *dīc, mē cum eō pācis inīre fœdus* ("say that I make a covenant of peace with him"): *mē* is the subject of *inīre*, *cum eō* goes with *fœdus*; not *mēcum* (proofread, 2026-11-16)
*in mē cum Isæidā cōnspīrāstis* ("conspired against me with the son of Jesse"): *in mē* is the object, *cum Isæidā* goes with the verb; not *mēcum* (reader r7, 2026-11-20)
